Package org.checkerframework.framework.stub

Class BinaryStubBundleTest

java.lang.Object
org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubBundleTest
public class BinaryStubBundleTest extends Object
Tests that a damaged binary stub bundle is reported as a malformed file, not a crash. Mirrors BinaryStubDataTest, which does the same for the per-file format that a bundle's entries are made of; see that class's documentation for why the files here are hand-built rather than produced by BinaryStubFileGenerator and then damaged.

Unlike a per-file binary stub, a bundle's own container is not GZIP-compressed (only each entry's bytes are; see BinaryStubBundle's class documentation), so these bytes are built directly, uncompressed.
